relaxed_comparison.method: Original/relaxed/relaxed/original per prompt on one resident model. Eight task types. Current target four-bit experts and K3 draft remain. Neural spans use the previously measured relaxed three-token policy. Lookup remains greedy. New prompts use empty caches, with all prompt processing inside request timing. Source review uses the checked 23860-token saved prefix. Load, warmup, compilation, source checks, and diagnostics are outside timing. Natural stopping is retained. Actual task success, errors, and speed determine the quality tradeoff; output equality is not an acceptance condition.

cost_window_comparison.method: Relaxed/role3/probes4/probes4/role3/relaxed per prompt on one resident model. Same eight prompts and weights as the first comparison. Role3 uses target choices at special/end tokens and ends the response at an assistant-role marker. Ordinary words retain the relaxed 0.03/0.1 posterior and three-token cap. Probes4 adds four cost samples before disabling neural proposals; lookup cost remains unchanged. New tasks time all prompt processing; source review uses the checked 23860-token prefix. Load, compilation, warmup and diagnostics are outside timing. Judge natural task completion and speed. Exact output is not an acceptance condition.

content_notes.source_review: All variants retain useful loader/cache coverage and the same false one-bit width and 79+ layer claims. Both controls and candidates are incomplete at 512 tokens. Retain the measured speed gain.
content_notes.incident_summary: All variants preserve the supplied incident facts, four bullets and no invented fan-failure cause.
content_notes.maintenance_email: All variants retain required date/time, impact, data retention, no action and existing status page; wording differs.
content_notes.cache_explanation: Probes4 is reasonably close and faster. It adds an incorrect universal statement that the first run is always slower. Its CPU-internal-code explanation is imprecise; both baseline and candidate omit process-lifetime conditions for retained data. Record these changes alongside the speed gain.

quality_scope: Eight task types. Generated interval functions pass 519 behavior cases. Inventory, invoice and selected scheduling answers pass their semantic checks. Incident and email answers retain supplied facts. Review remains incomplete at 512 tokens and adds false one-bit and 79+ layer claims. The selected cache explanation adds an incorrect universal claim that the first run is always slower. These observed errors are recorded with the speed gains.
timing_scope: Each comparison is balanced within one resident model load. The two comparisons use separate processes. New-prompt processing is inside request time. Source review uses 23,860 saved prompt tokens. Load, compilation, warmup, hashes and diagnostics are outside timing. Output lengths can differ; both throughput and total request time are reported.
integration: The measured private generator is implemented directly in exlr8/mtp.py. Release tests cover relaxed words, actual token history, four neural cost samples, prompt lookup, fallback and response completion. The integrated release was not measured in a separate full-model timing run.
